strips.hook: Universal confessed behavior: treating 'not opening the renewal/price-hike notice' as a disciplined choice instead of avoidance. Reddit r/sales radar was unreachable today (network-blocked fetch), so per ig-lessons.md fail-soft this fell back to mining the canonical lived-moment space, seasoned by today's SaaStr coverage of vendors hiking renewal prices after service neglect (Source 1: 'Your Agents Are About to Start Firing Your Vendors...').
strips.caption:
The most disciplined choice you'll make all week is not opening that email.
Cal's found his own name for it. Four years running.
